title: Full Body Laser Hair Removal Dubai: Price
h1: Full body laser hair removal in Dubai: areas, sessions and price
desc: Full body laser hair removal in Dubai: which areas are included, how long a session takes, how many sessions you need and prices from AED 499 + VAT.
answer: Full body laser hair removal treats all the main areas in one visit: legs, arms, underarms, bikini, chest, tummy and back. A session takes about 60 to 90 minutes, and most people need 6 to 8 sessions. At Skin & Laser full body costs AED 550 + VAT per session, AED 1,500 + VAT for 3 sessions or AED 2,800 + VAT for 6. Full body without front and back is AED 499 + VAT per session.
body:
## Why choose full body

Treating everything together is the best value per area and saves repeated visits. It also keeps all areas on the same schedule, so you finish the course at the same time.

## What's included

- Full legs and full arms
- Underarms and bikini
- Chest, tummy and back (full body option)
- Face can be added on request

## Planning your course

Book sessions 4 to 6 weeks apart, shave everything the day before, and keep all areas out of the sun. See our [preparation guide](/blog/laser-hair-removal-preparation-guide/) for details.

faq: How long does a full body session take?
Is full body cheaper than separate areas?
Yes, it costs less than booking the same areas one by one.
Can men have full body laser?
Yes. Men often add the back and shoulders. See [laser hair removal for men](/laser-hair-removal-for-men/).
